questions.prompt: A seat finishes a task but leaves one of the board's rules unanswered. What happens?

choices.text: The task finishes with a warning
choices.why: An unanswered rule refuses the finish.
Only a claim answers a rule; a finish that leaves one unanswered is refused, naming it.
Rules are the operator's; a seat cannot skip one.

questions.prompt: What does task stamp <task> changes need?

choices.why: changes without --text is refused before it is sent.
The assignee needs to know what to change, so the text is required.

questions.prompt: Which seats can work the tasks on a board?

choices.text: Only seats with a line to the board
choices.why: No line reaches a board; reach does.

choices.text: Seats in its region, a region inside it, or a region around it
choices.why: A seat reaches resources in its own region, the regions inside it and the regions around it, never a sibling's.
A board in a sibling region is out of reach.
Ordinary seats work boards in their reach.
